subject: Error in units of plant transpiration?

messages.author: 606bdb90568efad9
messages.subject: Error in units of plant transpiration?
parts: What are units of plant transpiration returned in plant$TRANS? Help files suggest kg/m^2/s, but with values ranging up to ~700, that seems too high by several orders of magnitude.

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: Error in units of plant transpiration?
parts:
Good spotting Ilya - the units should be g/m2/h and I've now updated this on github. Apologies for the confusion.

All the best,
Mike
